description: Increased expression of a target human gene following shRNA knockdown or CRISPR knockout of the source gene. Each edge represents a positive, statistically significant consensus expression change across the pooled perturbation signatures; the source gene and target gene are distinct.

common_properties.name: z_score
common_properties.description: Signed Stouffer consensus z-score for the source–target pair; positive for this upregulation relationship.
common_properties.notes: Carries magnitude; sign is consistent with the edge's up/down type

common_properties.name: p_value
common_properties.description: Bonferroni-corrected two-tailed normal p-value, corrected separately for each perturbed gene and target-gene tier. Edges pass significance at α = 0.05.

common_properties.name: tier
common_properties.description: Target-gene quality tier: landmark genes are directly measured; BING denotes well-inferred, non-landmark genes.

common_properties.name: n_signatures
common_properties.description: Number of pooled signatures combined into the perturbed gene’s consensus profile.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Source attribution for the knockdown perturbation relationship.
common_properties.notes: Single-element list under this source; list, never scalar

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the edge was created or last updated.

source_contributions.scope: LINCS L1000 / Connectivity Map GEO series GSE92742 (Phase I) and GSE70138 (Phase II). Includes raw shRNA (trt_sh) and CRISPR knockout (trt_xpr) signatures pooled by perturbed gene. Excludes precomputed shRNA consensus (trt_sh.cgs), seed-labeled signatures (trt_sh.css), poorly inferred non-BING targets, and self-edges. Both endpoint genes must be present in SPOKE.
source_contributions.description: Signatures are pooled across cell lines, doses, times, and both GEO series into a consensus profile using correlation-weighted Stouffer integration. Significance is assessed separately for directly measured landmark targets and well-inferred non-landmark BING targets using Bonferroni correction at α = 0.05. All significant landmark targets are retained; the BING tier is limited to the top 1,000 significant targets per perturbed gene. No touchstone restriction is applied.
